main.name: Vasu Sharma
main.title: Senior Software Engineer
main.bio: I build things at Google — from agent security to prompt injection defenses. By day, I'm an engineer shaping how the world's AI stays safe. By night, I'm either exploring a new trail in the Swiss Alps or deep in a rabbit hole building chess engines, torrent clients, and other systems from scratch. I believe the best engineers are the ones who never stop wandering — through codebases, through ideas, through the world.

journey.title: Senior Software Engineer
highlights: Leading the Agent Observability team, working on data driven agent security efforts and building data pipelines ingesting data from agents across Google
Research work on integrated and standalone security classifiers in the Agentic world.
Working on internal Python RPC framework, adding new features like request-interceptor / middleware support - used by teams in Shopping, Search, Gemini etc.

journey.title: Software Engineer III — Agent Security
highlights: Founding member of Agent Observability team — tracking AI agents across Google - from capabilities to their security posture, and risk vectors like 'Lethal Trifecta'
Added security features to harden Agent frameworks with output normalisation and capability controls
Researched novel Agent Architectures to promote secure-by-design patterns preventing prompt injection risks

journey.title: Software Engineer III — Model Armor
highlights: Founding Engineer of Model Armor – a Google Cloud service screening LLM prompts and responses for safety risks
Reduced p90 E2E response time by 75% through quantization and infrastructure optimizations, saving $M/year
Enhanced prompt injection & jailbreak detection with native multi-lingual and long-context support

journey.title: Software Engineer II — Parameter Manager
highlights: Founding Engineer in GCP's Parameter Manager — extension of Secret Manager for YAML/JSON application parameters
Worked on rendering secrets within parameters, customer demos, and E2E testing with continuous probes

journey.title: Application Engineer II
highlights: Standardized active device telemetry data collection from datacenter hardware — handling billions of events daily
Founded centralized 'Policy Manager' for Cloud Capacity Policies with versioning, RBAC, and CEL evaluation engine
Built application tracking carbon emissions data of suppliers for Google's net-zero initiative

journey.title: ML Research Intern
highlights: Researched novel OCR techniques — implemented CRAFT architecture and trained on custom data
Shifted ML workloads to containerized Kubernetes pipelines, improving availability and reducing costs
Built full-stack app for continuous human feedback with automated model retraining

journey.title: Summer Analyst
highlights: Redesigned workflow configuration UI with React and TypeScript — reduced user onboarding time from 3 weeks to days
